cards.title: Book Online Travel Agencies and redeem points to get cash back up to 18% when you meet the spending conditions and redeem points equal to the amount spent.
cards.detailDescription:
Redeem points to get cash back up to 18% when spend at website and application Agoda, Klook,Traveloka and Trip.com and redeem Thank You Rewards points/ M Point equal to the amount spent per sales slip.

 

# Tier 1: Get 15% cash back when spend 2,500 baht or more per sales slip.

# Tier 2: For Pinnacle, Infinite, Platinum leader,Bangkok Bank M Legend/M Luxe credit cards: Get 18% cash back when spend 20,000 baht or more per sales slip.

 

• No maximum point redemptions limited throughout the campaign., Only purchases made with Bangkok Bank M Visa credit card are eligible for redemption of M Point points.
• Send SMS registration of each transaction within promotion period.

Type BOTA followed by 16 digits of your credit card number and followed by* spending amount. (without decimal amount and ,) and send SMS to 4545666 (3 Baht/SMS).

Example: Spending amount of 3,500.75 baht Type BOTA 1111222233334444*3500

 

Promotion period: May 1, 2026 - August 31, 2026.
